method: Real production Chromium viewport screenshots and native Playwright browser videos. H.264 transcodes retain original timing. Native wheel input drives forward and reverse expansion; controls and real links are operated through browser input. No timeline seeking, style injection or synthesized frames. Full-page stills use the software compositor to avoid cloud SwiftShader tall-image repetition. Mobile is Chromium touch/viewport emulation, not a physical-device benchmark.
